facts.note: At dinner, when the temple struck nine, the husband (Aurèle) had everyone show their watches; Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine, and Aurèle scolded him in front of everyone.
In the salon, when the temple struck ten, Madame looked at the salon clock on the mantel, which showed five minutes to ten.
She and the doctor (Casimir) played piquet in the salon without a break until he went out for his cigars, leaving at twenty-eight minutes past ten by the salon clock.
As he left he asked her to play for him; she sat at the piano at once, played until he came back, and stopped when he came in.
A moment after he came back, the hall clock struck eleven.
